items.name: Hold Still

data.name: Hold Still
data.description: "Hold still." The glass to the north and south of you goes quiet. It does not mind you staying where you are; it minds where you would go.
data.battleDescription: "Hold still." The glass either side of %target goes quiet. It minds where you would go, not where you are.

items.name: The Silence Holds Her

data.name: The Silence Holds Her
data.description: The Silence folds around her the way it once folded around her through the feelers, but there is no feeler now to cut. The hold is hers: blows slide off it and feed it, and the floor close about her goes still. One clean break would shatter all of it at once.
data.battleDescription: The Silence folds around %user. Blows slide off and feed it. One clean break would shatter it.

items.name: Nothing Moves Again

data.name: Nothing Moves Again
data.description: The stillness about her closes. Whatever was standing that near her stops, and does not move again until she allows it.
data.battleDescription: For a moment nothing near the Silence moves. Nothing can, until something clean washes it off.

items.name: Remainder Lancet

data.name: Remainder Lancet
data.description: A needle of black glass, flicked from the wall faster than the old ones. Each one steadies her hand for the next; time lets the steadiness go, and so does a clean break.
data.battleDescription: %user flicks a lancet of black glass at %target. Each one steadies her hand for the next.

items.name: The Names Stir

data.name: The Names Stir
data.description: The names press up against the glass from below, waiting for her to weaken a little more. When they rise, the quiet will cover the floor and nothing on it will mend, except where the three refused. What you carry in is all you will have.
data.battleDescription: The names press up against the glass from below. "Soon nothing here will mend. Except where the three refused."

items.name: No One Will Be Mended

data.name: No One Will Be Mended
data.description: "Nothing mends here. Nothing needs to." The quiet covers the floor, and for a long while no wound on it will close. Only where the three refused do wounds still mend.
data.battleDescription: "Nothing mends here. Nothing needs to." The quiet covers the floor. What you carried in is all you have.

items.name: Every Name Remembered

data.name: Every Name Remembered
data.description: "Do you hear them? Every one of them stayed." The names rise under the whole floor except the three places where the porter, the sister and the cadet refused. But the glass also remembers what she traced into it, and memory does not always agree with the light.
data.battleDescription: "Do you hear them? Every one of them stayed." The names rise. Three places stay dry: where the three refused.

items.name: The Remainder's Hush

data.name: The Remainder's Hush
data.description: While she remembers, stilled pools seep up through the floor. Standing in one empties you, and nothing mends there.
data.battleDescription: The floor stops making sound in patches. Nothing mends in them.

items.name: Hush Where They Stood

data.name: Hush Where They Stood
data.description: The quiet finds one of the three dry places and seeps into it. Whoever waits there empties and cannot mend, and two places remain.
data.battleDescription: The quiet seeps into one of the places where the three refused. Two remain.

items.name: A Good Impression

data.name: A Good Impression
data.description: "There. Hold still, and you will make a good impression." The ceiling cracks, and the glass begins to give back everything she ever drew in it. She holds nothing back now, not even her guard.
data.battleDescription: "There. Hold still, and you will make a good impression." The ceiling cracks.

items.name: Glassfall: First Echo

data.name: Glassfall: First Echo
data.description: A third of the ceiling falls, and with it the first lines she ever drew, in the light they were drawn in. The next pane is already cracking, and she guards nothing while it falls.
data.battleDescription: A third of the ceiling falls, and with it the first lines she ever drew. The next pane cracks.

items.name: Glassfall: Second Echo

data.name: Glassfall: Second Echo
data.description: A third of the ceiling falls, and with it the heart she etched in the Stilling. The next pane is already cracking, and she guards nothing while it falls.
data.battleDescription: A third of the ceiling falls, and with it the heart. The next pane cracks.

items.name: Glassfall: Last Echo

data.name: Glassfall: Last Echo
data.description: A third of the ceiling falls, and with it the seam she traced down the west wall. The first pane cracks again; the ceiling goes round the hall the way a clock does.
data.battleDescription: A third of the ceiling falls, and with it the seam. The first pane cracks again.

items.name: Every Line Through You

data.name: Every Line Through You
data.description: "Hold still." A line of glass runs north and south through where you stand. It will bear one who stays; it will not bear one who walks along it.
data.battleDescription: "Hold still." A line of glass runs through %target. It bears one who stays, not one who walks along it.

items.name: An Absence
An Absence

data.name: An Absence
data.description: Something settles beside you; the floor there stops making sound.
data.battleDescription: An Absence settles beside %target. The floor there has stopped making sound.

data.description: While her shadow stands beside her, she cannot hear herself think. Silence it, and Sayo hears every thought again, and her glass cuts deeper for it.
data.battleDescription: The hall is suddenly very loud. %user straightens. "I can hear myself again." Her glass cuts deeper.

items.name: Your Likeness: final

data.name: Your Likeness
data.description: "Hold still. There. That is you." When she is badly hurt, she pours an impression of you out of the glass. It fights the way you fight, but an impression is thin, and it does not last.
data.battleDescription: "Hold still. There. That is you." Your likeness steps out of the glass, thin as an impression.

items.name: Your Own Strike: final

data.name: Your Own Strike
data.description: Your likeness strikes exactly the way you would, straight through the guard you trust. It has learned only your habits, and only for a little while.
data.battleDescription: %user strikes exactly the way you would, straight through the guard you trust.

items.name: The Hush: final

data.name: The Hush
data.description: Where her shadow passes, sound stops and does not come back. The still pools it leaves stay a long time; whatever stands in them slowly empties, and no wound there will close.
data.battleDescription: Somewhere on the floor, sound stops. Nothing standing in the quiet will mend.

items.name: The Hush, Unbridled: final

data.name: The Hush, Unbridled
data.description: Nothing holds the quiet back now. It pours up through the floor faster than it ever did, and the pools it leaves wound whatever stands in them. Clean floor grows scarce.
data.battleDescription: Nothing holds the quiet back now. It pours up out of the floor in still, dark pools.

items.name: The Listening: final

data.name: The Listening
data.description: Something under the floor turns toward the sound of you. A feeler of the deep rises and listens, and while any part of the deep still lives in the hall, it keeps hold of her.
data.battleDescription: Something under the floor turns toward the sound of you. While it lives, the deep holds her.

items.name: The Listening, Unbridled: final

data.name: The Listening, Unbridled
data.description: It no longer waits to hear you. The feelers rise one after another now, and as long as one of them lives, the deep keeps its hold on her.
data.battleDescription: It no longer waits to hear you. Another feeler rises, and the deep tightens its hold on her.

items.name: Stillness: final

data.name: Stillness
data.description: The floor around the Silence goes still, and everything near her begins to stop. Nothing close to her moves for long. The far side of the hall is still loud.
data.battleDescription: The floor around the Silence goes still. Close to her, nothing moves for long.

items.name: Nothing Moves: final

data.name: Nothing Moves
data.description: For a moment nothing near the Silence moves, and nothing can. Those it holds are crushed, and for a few rounds after their wounds close slowly and open easily, until something clean washes the stillness off.
data.battleDescription: For a moment nothing near the Silence moves. Nothing can, until something clean washes it off.

items.name: Cradle: final

data.name: Cradle
data.description: The deep closes around her like cupped hands, and blows slide off the glass. It holds her only while something of the deep still lives in the hall, and nothing can pry the hold loose but that.
data.battleDescription: The deep closes around %target. Blows slide off the glass while any feeler lives.

items.name: Grasp: final

data.name: Grasp
data.description: The feeler closes around whatever is nearest, without a sound. What it holds cannot move for a moment and slowly empties, and the floor beneath a held thing does not wait for it.
data.battleDescription: %user closes around %target without a sound. The floor beneath does not wait.

items.name: Etching: Rime: final

data.name: Etching: Rime
data.description: She traces the north of the hall into the glass. It rimes over, glows, and fades. The glass forgets nothing she draws.
data.battleDescription: %user traces the north of the hall into the glass. It rimes over and fades, but the glass forgets nothing.

items.name: Recast: Rime: final

data.name: Recast: Rime
data.description: The glass remembers the rime, and the north of the hall breaks with nothing to show where. Only someone who also remembers will be standing elsewhere. For a breath after the glass answers her, her own guard hangs open.
data.battleDescription: The glass remembers the rime, and the north of the hall breaks. For a breath, her guard hangs open.

items.name: Etching: Ember: final

data.name: Etching: Ember
data.description: She traces the south of the hall into the glass. It glows like an ember, then fades from sight, but not from the glass.
data.battleDescription: %user traces the south of the hall into the glass. It fades from sight, not from the glass.

items.name: Recast: Ember: final

data.name: Recast: Ember
data.description: The glass remembers the ember, and the south of the hall breaks without a mark. The ember was shown once, and once is all it gets. While the glass answers, she is open to anyone who stayed whole.
data.battleDescription: The glass remembers the ember, and the south of the hall breaks. For a breath, her guard hangs open.

items.name: Etching: Seam: final

data.name: Etching: Seam
data.description: She traces a seam down the west wall. It glows, then sinks into the glass, which keeps it the way a scar keeps a cut.
data.battleDescription: %user traces a seam down the west wall. It sinks into the glass the way a scar keeps a cut.

items.name: Recast: Seam: final

data.name: Recast: Seam
data.description: The glass remembers the seam, and the west wall breaks, unmarked. The scar was always there for anyone who watched it sink in. Her guard stays open for a breath after the glass answers.
data.battleDescription: The glass remembers the seam, and the west wall breaks. For a breath, her guard hangs open.

items.name: Etching: Heart: final

data.name: Etching: Heart
data.description: She traces the heart of the hall into the glass. It beats once, then fades. The glass keeps the rhythm long after the light is gone.
data.battleDescription: %user traces the heart of the hall into the glass. It beats once and fades; the glass keeps the rhythm.

items.name: Recast: Heart: final

data.name: Recast: Heart
data.description: The glass remembers the heart, and the middle of the hall breaks, unmarked. The edges that never glowed are the only ones it does not remember. For a breath afterward her own guard hangs open.
data.battleDescription: The glass remembers the heart, and the middle of the hall breaks. For a breath, her guard hangs open.

items.name: Etching: Hail: final

data.name: Etching: Hail
data.description: She taps a scatter of points into the glass, like hail. Each one glows and fades, and each one is remembered, exactly where it fell.
data.battleDescription: %user taps a scatter of points into the glass, like hail. Each fades exactly where it fell.

items.name: Recast: Hail: final

data.name: Recast: Hail
data.description: The glass remembers every point of hail, and all of them break at once, unmarked. Between the points it remembers there is room to stand. In the moment the glass answers, she stands open.
data.battleDescription: The glass remembers every point of hail, and all of them break at once. For a breath, her guard hangs open.

items.name: The Hush Rises: final

data.name: The Hush Rises
data.description: While she etches, the Silence seeps up through the floor in still patches that never close. More of them rise every time she draws, and whatever stands in one empties fast and cannot mend.
data.battleDescription: The floor stops making sound in patches. More rise each time she draws, and they never close.

items.name: The Glass Falls Quiet: final

data.name: The Glass Falls Quiet
data.description: "Again." She lowers her hand, and for a moment the hall rests. In the lull, someone worn steps out of the glass, and the next pattern is already waiting in her fingers.
data.battleDescription: %user lowers her hand. "Again." The hall rests, and something worn steps out of the glass.

items.name: Raise the Gate Porter: final

data.name: Raise the Gate Porter
data.description: The gate porter steps out of the glass, thin as old paper, still holding the door he would not open on the night of the Stilling. He has never stood farther from her glass than this; she cannot let him. He keeps his threshold close and clears it of anyone who stands too near, wherever the step back lands them.
data.battleDescription: The gate porter steps out of the glass, still holding a door that is not there. He clears his threshold of anyone too near.

items.name: Raise Sister Hana: final

data.name: Raise Sister Hana
data.description: Sister Hana steps out of the glass, worn thin, hands already busy with someone else's wounds; she would not stop tending them when the hall went still. She comes no farther than Sayo can reach, and there she mends Sayo as she mended everyone. She will not stop on her own.
data.battleDescription: Sister Hana steps out of the glass, hands already busy. She will mend Sayo until someone stops her.

items.name: Raise Cadet Tomo: final

data.name: Raise Cadet Tomo
data.description: Cadet Tomo steps out of the glass, faint at the edges, rope in hand; told to hold still that night, he ran, and the glass only half caught him. He can run no farther than her reach now. His line reaches a long way, and it does not care what floor it drags you across.
data.battleDescription: Cadet Tomo steps out of the glass, rope in hand. His line reaches a long way.

items.name: Doorward Sweep: final

data.name: Doorward Sweep
data.description: "Gate's closed." The gate porter sweeps the threshold clear with a heavy blow, and whoever stood there is put a step outside, onto whatever floor was behind them.
data.battleDescription: "Gate's closed." %user sweeps the threshold clear, onto whatever floor lay behind.

items.name: Worn Mending: final

data.name: Worn Mending
data.description: "Hold still, it's nearly done." Sister Hana tends Sayo, closing her wounds a little at a time. She has done this for so long she no longer knows how to stop; someone will have to stop her.
data.battleDescription: "Hold still, it's nearly done." %user tends to %target. She will not stop on her own.

items.name: Cadet's Tether: final

data.name: Cadet's Tether
data.description: "Line's secure!" Tomo throws his line and hauls, and you come in several steps with it. The rope does not look down at the floor it pulls you over.
data.battleDescription: "Line's secure!" %user hauls %target in, over whatever floor lies between.
